client ask (r&d) no pehlo point. koi pan website par kaam chalu karta pehla client no main goal clear hovo joiye - bija badha decisions (keywords, design, content) aa goal par j depend kare chhe. kema important? goal vagar seo karo to traffic aave pan business ne faydo na thay. example: client ne leads joiye ane tame blog traffic vadharo - traffic aavyu, inquiry nahi. etle pehla goal, pachhi strategy. client ne aa questions puchho main goal su chhe? sales (ecommerce), leads/inquiries (service), ya branding/awareness? business model su chhe? b2b (business ne vechay) ke b2c (direct customer ne)? revenue kya thi aave chhe? kaya product/service thi sauthi vadhare kamai thay chhe? 6-12 mahina ma su achieve karvu chhe? number ma - da. 100 leads/month, 2x sales. atyare marketing kya thi chale chhe? instagram, ads, referral, offline? success kevi rite mapse? calls, form fills, orders, store visits? checklist main goal ek vakya ma lakhelu chhe b2b ke b2c clear chhe success na numbers fix chhe goal na adhare j aagal nu planning thay chhe khas tip client bole "badhu j joiye" to priority puchho: "jo next 3 mahina ma fakt ek j vastu improve thay, te kayi?" - te j real goal chhe.

customer kon chhe ane kya chhe - be vastu clear hoy to j sacha keywords, content ane design bane. generic website badha mate, pan sales targeted website thi j aave. customer persona banavo kon chhe? umar group, gender, job, aavak nu level. online shu search kare chhe? customer google ma su lakhe te exact words note karo. temni samasya (problem) su chhe? je solution mate te search kare chhe. kya decision le chhe? mobile par ke laptop? whatsapp ke email? location decide karo local dhando (salon, repair, classes): city + area keywords, google business profile jaruri chhe. india-level (india ecom/services): india-first keywords, hindi/gujarati/english mix content kaam kare chhe. international (us/uk clients): english content, tya ni spelling (color vs colour), tya na competitors check karo. udaharan surat ni bakery: target = surat na 20-45 varas na loko, birthday/eggless cake search karta. keywords: "eggless cake surat", "birthday cake delivery surat". usa client nu software: target = us small business owners, keywords in english, competitor us-based. checklist 1 clear customer persona lakhyo chhe location: local / india / international decide karel chhe customer na exact search words collect karela chhe

usp etle unique selling point - tamara client ma aevu su chhe je competitor ma nathi? usp clear hoy to title, content ane ads badha sharp bane. usp na hoy to website "beeja jevi j" lage ane google pan ene special rank nahi aape. usp kevi rite shodho top 5 competitors ni website kholo ane temna homepage na main claims note karo. su offer kare chhe je bija nahi karta? free delivery, same-day service, 10 varas experience, lowest price, handmade, warranty? customers sauthi vadhare su vakhan kare chhe? reviews vanchi ne pattern shodho. client ne seedho puchho: "customer tamne j kema pasand kare chhe?" usp ne kya vaparvo homepage na h1 ane title ma meta description ma (ctr vadharva) product/service pages na first paragraph ma schema ma (offer, pricerange) example bija badha jewellers "best designs" lakhe chhe. jo client 100% bis hallmark ane lifetime exchange aape chhe - te j usp chhe. homepage par "bis hallmark gold | lifetime exchange" bolu joiye, "welcome to our website" nahi. checklist 1 main usp + 2 supporting usp lakhela chhe usp homepage na h1/title ma dekhay chhe usp competitor na claims thi different chhe (copy nathi)

customer koi product nahi, potani problem nu solution search kare chhe. jo website problem first address kare ane pachhi solution aape, to google ma pan rank saru male ane conversion pan. problem kevi rite shodho customer reviews vanchho - client na ane competitor na be. loko su complain kare chhe? google "people also ask" ma keyword lakhine juvo - te real problems chhe. quora/reddit/youtube comments ma niche na prashno juvo. client ne puchho: "customer phone par sauthi vadhare su puche chhe?" problem thi solution nu mapping har problem mate ek answer: problem = blog topic / faq question solution = service/product page content example: "cake delivery late thay chhe" problem → "same-day cake delivery in surat - order before 4 pm" page aa data kya vaparvu faq section (aeo/geo mate pan best) blog topics - problem keywords long-tail hoy, rank karva easy service page headings ma customer nu j word vapru checklist top 10 customer problems ni list chhe har problem nu solution page/blog ma mapped chhe faq ma real customer questions add karela chhe

research sop a practical, step-by-step guide to discovering, validating, and organizing organic search competitors document purpose scope build an accurate competitor list for the selected target country and industry. five methods: domain overview, keyword-based serp research, keyword gap, position tracking, and manual google serp research. important scope note: traffic & market analysis, advertising research, and backlink gap have been excluded as requested. the remaining methods are renumbered in a clean sequence. 1. objective and research approach the objective is to identify websites that compete with our website in organic search results for the selected target country. the research should produce a verified list of relevant competitor domains, supported by keyword and visibility data. use the methods in the order below. start with domain overview to build the base list, then use keyword and serp research to discover additional domains. finally, validate relevance and remove duplicates. method 1 — domain overview: identify the main organic competitors and shortlist 50 domains. method 2 — keyword-based research: find domains ranking for our high-volume keywords. method 3 — keyword gap: find competitors ranking for relevant keywords that our website is missing or ranking weakly for. method 4 — position tracking: discover domains repeatedly appearing for our tracked target keywords. method 5 — manual google serp research: validate which websites actually appear in organic results for important searches. 2. before starting — prepare the research step 1 — confirm the website and target market write down our exact website domain (example used in the original notes: client-a-store.com). confirm the target country for this research. use the same country consistently across country-specific reports. list the main products, services, and business categories offered by our website. prepare a spreadsheet to store raw exports, keyword data, serp results, and the final competitor list. step 2 — create the research spreadsheet keep original exports and working data. do not overwrite raw research when preparing the final shortlist. tab name what to store domain overview export original csv export: domain, country, competitor metrics, traffic, keywords, and cost. final competitors unique competitor domains, source method, target country, relevance, and final status. keyword research keyword, volume, country volumes, kd, intent, cpc, trend, and our position where available. serp results keyword, serp position, domain, ranking url, include/exclude decision, and reason. method notes research date, selected database/country, filters used, and observations. 3. method 1 — domain overview purpose: use our domain's organic competitor report to identify the main websites competing with us in the selected market. this method creates the base competitor list. step 1 — open domain overview and enter our domain start with our own website, not a competitor domain. open semrush and go to the “domain overview” section. enter our complete website domain in the domain search field. set the country/database selector to “worldwide” for the initial overview, as specified in the original workflow. run the report and wait for the overview dashboard to load. expected output: our website's domain overview report is displayed. step 2 — open main organic competitors find the “main organic competitors” card on the overview page. click “view details” inside that card. open the “competitors” tab in the detailed report. review the competitor domains shown in the report. expected output: a detailed list of domains identified as organic competitors. step 3 — select the target country in the competitors report, find the country/database selector. choose the target country for which competitor research is being conducted. allow the report to refresh for the selected country. review the domains and metrics shown for that market. expected output: a country-specific competitor list. use this country consistently in the final research. step 4 — export the complete competitor data review the available pages or result rows in the competitor report. export all available pages/results rather than exporting only the first visible page. choose csv as the export format. open the downloaded csv file in excel or google sheets. keep an untouched copy of the original csv in the “domain overview export” tab or source file. expected output: a complete raw export that can be filtered without losing the original data. step 5 — apply the five competitor filters use the five filters from the original research process. apply them to the exported competitor data and review the strongest matching rows. apply “top 10 com. level” and shortlist the top-performing rows under this filter. apply “top 10 common keywords” and shortlist domains with strong keyword overlap. apply “top 10 se keywords” and shortlist domains with strong organic keyword coverage. apply “top 10 traffic” and shortlist domains with the highest traffic values. apply “top 10 costs” and shortlist domains with the highest traffic-cost values. compare the shortlisted rows across all five filters. remove duplicate domains from the working shortlist. select 50 competitors in total for the target country. save these domains in a separate tab named “final competitors”. expected output: a finalized base list of 50 main organic competitors for the selected country. filter name how to use it top 10 com. level shortlist the top rows shown by the com. level filter/metric in the export. top 10 common keywords shortlist domains sharing the most common organic keywords with our website. top 10 se keywords shortlist domains with the strongest organic keyword coverage under this filter. top 10 traffic shortlist domains with the highest estimated organic traffic. top 10 costs shortlist domains with the highest estimated traffic cost. note: keep the filter labels as they appear in the semrush report/export. the original workflow specifies these five filters; it does not define a separate weighting formula for combining them. 4. method 2 — keyword-based competitor research purpose: discover competitors from the actual search results for our important keywords. this can reveal relevant domains that may not appear in the domain overview competitor list. step 1 — open organic rankings and add our website open the “organic rankings” section in semrush. enter our own website domain. example from the original notes: client-a-store.com. open the “positions” tab. confirm that the report is showing our website's organic keyword positions. expected output: a list of keywords for which our website ranks. step 2 — sort and shortlist high-volume quick win etle aevi opportunities je ocha effort ma jaldi result aape. navi site par 3-6 mahina lage, pan quick wins 2-4 week ma movement batave. quick wins kevi rite shodho position 5-20 vala pages: search console ma juvo kaya keywords par page 5-20 position par chhe - title, description, content thodu improve karo ne top 5 ma aavi shake. low kd + sara volume keywords: je competitors e miss karela. people also ask na questions: faq add karo ne featured snippet male. zero-click sudhara: title/description ctr improve karo - same position par pan traffic vadhare. orphan ane thin pages fix karo: je pages ne koi link nathi, tene link aapo. priority nakki karvanu formula quick win = (saru potential traffic) x (ochu effort). pehla te karo je 1 kalak ma thay ane 30 divas ma result batave. checklist search console mathi top 10 opportunity pages listed 5 low-kd keywords pasand karela dar quick win mate owner ane deadline fix chhe

seo marathon chhe, sprint nahi. 6 mahina nu realistic plan banavvo etle client pan wait kare ane kaam pan systematic chale. mahina-pramane plan month 1: full audit (on-page, technical, content) karo, quick wins implement karo, gsc/ga4 setup verify karo. month 2: on-page fixes (title, meta, headings, internal links) karo, must-have pages complete karo. month 3: content engine chalu - week ma 2-4 blogs, keyword gap cover karva. month 4: off-page chalu - backlinks, reddit/quora, social signals. month 5: content update (old pages refresh), schema ane aeo/geo optimization. month 6: review su work karyu, su nahi. double down on working pages, strategy adjust. tracking dar mahine: impressions, clicks, position (gsc), users (ga4), leads/sales note karo apeksha: mahina 1-2 ma flat, mahina 3-4 ma movement, mahina 5-6 ma visible growth checklist 6 mahina nu written plan chhe monthly metrics track thay chhe client ne timeline pehle divas e j samjavi chhe

saru domain name = brand nu foundation. lamba term ma seo, branding ane marketing badha ma faydo kare. 3 rules (notebook pramane) keyword pramane: main keyword domain ma hoy to relevance signal male (da. "suratcakes.in"). pan exact-match domain par over-optimize nahi - brand + keyword mix best. country pramane: india target to .in, global to .com. local trust mate country domain better rank kare te country ma. yaad rakhva easy: 2-3 words max, spelling easy, phone par bolva ma samjay aevu, no hyphens/numbers jo avoid thay to. check karvana steps namecheap/godaddy ma availability check karo same name instagram/facebook/youtube handle ma pan male te juvo google ma name search karo - koi existing brand/negative result to nahi? trademark conflict to nahi (india ma ipindia.gov.in) example "radhavision infotech" - brand name short, yaad rahi jay evu, .com available, social handles same. ekdam perfect combination. checklist short (2-3 words), spell-easy, bolva-easy sachu extension (.com / .in) social handles available chhe trademark conflict nathi

competitors je keywords par rank kare chhe ane tame nahi - te list j tamari next 3-6 mahina ni content strategy chhe. gap analysis = ready-made roadmap. steps (pagla) tool select karo: semrush (keyword gap tool), ahrefs (content gap), ke free option - ubersuggest + manual google search. tamaru domain vs 3-4 competitors enter karo. filter: competitors top 20 ma, tame 50+ ke absent - te keywords export karo. cluster karo: similar keywords ne group karo - ek group = ek page/blog (keyword cannibalization avoid karva). priority set karo: volume x (1/kd) x business relevance - je highest te pehla. manual method (tool vagar) main keyword search karo, competitor na top pages open karo, temna h2/h3 topics note karo - tame cover karel nathi te gap chhe google "people also ask" ane "related searches" manually note karo (ke semrush questions / alsoasked jeva tools) - automated scraping nahi output nu format sheet: keyword | volume | kd | competitor ranking | tamari status | priority | target page checklist gap keyword sheet taiyar chhe (50+ keywords) clusters banavela (ek cluster = ek page) next content batch mate top 10 priorities select karela chhe   path: keyword research/keyword overview semrush keyword overview step-by-step: validate a keyword before adding it to the content plan 1. prepare one keyword take a candidate from keyword gap, magic tool or the client's product list. begin with one exact phrase so its intent can be checked carefully. working example, real run on 19 nov 2026: diamond blades, united states, desktop. observed results: volume 1.0k, kd 32% (possible), global volume 6.4k (india 1.3k, us 1.0k, philippines 480, australia 390, uk 320, south africa 320), intent n/a, cpc $1.92, competitive density 1.00. keyword variations: 11.5k ideas, 125.1k total volume; top ones: raimondi diamond blade resin dressing stone (2.9k, kd 0%), diamond blade (1.9k, kd 9%), diamond saw blades (1.9k, kd 26%). questions: 491 ideas, 4.7k total volume; top ones: how to dress a diamond blade (260), can a diamond blade cut metal (210), how to sharpen a diamond blade (210). 2. open keyword overview open seo → keyword research → keyword overview. enter the phrase, choose the target country, and click search. optionally enter our domain for personalized metrics if available. do not confuse the domain box with the keyword box. local location settings apply only when a local analysis is intended. 3. record keyword metrics capture research date, database/location, device/date where shown, volume, global volume, kd %, intent, trend, cpc and competitive density. keep pkd, potential traffic and topical authority separate when domain-specific fields are available. kd describes general competition; pkd is tailored to the entered domain. missing data stays not available, not zero. 4. confirm intent in the serp review the serp analysis, its update date, top relevant urls and serp features. decide whether the query mainly needs a collection, product page, guide, comparison or local service page. example: do not map a buyer-focused blade query to a generic company about page. open relevant competitors to understand the task the searcher is trying to finish. 5. review variations and questions open keyword variations, questions and keyword strategy/cluster links where available. save only relevant terms that fit the proposed page. a question about safe material use needs verified manufacturer guidance. do not invent tool compatibility, blade size, rpm limits or safety instructions from a keyword suggestion. 6. use bulk analysis after validation use bulk analysis for a shortlist of up to 100 keywords. check the count and country before running. review intent, volume, kd, cpc and other selected columns. bulk analysis does not supply local metrics or a historical snapshot for every row in the same way as a single-keyword report. do not mix national and city-level values in one comparison. 7. save the decision and evidence tracker: keyword | database/location | research date | intent | volume | kd | pkd/domain if shown | trend | serp date/features | top reference urls | target page | keep/reject/review reason. save selec

ek j content ghana urls par khule (www/non-www, http/https, ?ref=, filters, variants) to google ne pasand karvu pade ke kayu url batavvu, ane links/signals vahenchai shake. canonical tag google ne kahe chhe: "aa content nu main url aa chhe". duplicate kya thi aave http vs https, www vs non-www, trailing slash / vs no slash tracking parameters (?utm=, ?ref=), sort/filter parameters shopify: /collections/x/products/y ane /products/y - same product be url print pages, tag pages, same description vala ghana product pages fix kevi rite self-canonical: dar indexable page par potana clean url no canonical. duplicate versions: main url taraf canonical (ya 301 jo duplicate url ni jarur j nathi). site-wide 301: http → https ane www/non-www mathi ek j version. noindex: je page users mate jaruri pan search mate nahi (thank-you, internal search, login) - meta robots noindex. internal links: hamesha canonical url ne j link karo - nahi to google ne mixed signal male. common mistakes (aa bhool na karo) noindex + robots.txt block sathe: robots block hoy to google noindex tag vanchi j na shake canonical ek page par ane sitemap/internal links bija url par - conflicting signals badha pages no canonical homepage par - pages index mathi nikli jay note: canonical ek hint chhe, order nahi (confirmed - google docs). signals consistent hoy to j google follow kare. checklist ek j preferred domain version (https + www ya non-www), baki 301 indexable pages par self-canonical sitemap internal links + can

url badlay, page delete thay, product band thay - dar vakhte saacho status code jaruri chhe. galat handling = backlinks waste, users frustrated, crawl budget waste. status codes simple bhasha ma 301: kayam mate move thayu - page ni value nava url ne pass thay. slug change, domain change, pages merge mate. 302: temporary move (sale page, a/b test). lambo time 302 rakhvu nahi. 404: page nathi. normal chhe - badha 404 problem nathi. 410: page kayam mate gayu - google 404 jevu j treat kare (farak bahu nano). soft 404: page "nathi" kahe pan status 200 aape, ke badha deleted pages homepage par redirect - google ene soft 404 gane. kevi rite check karvu screaming frog crawl → response codes → 3xx, 4xx filter. gsc → pages → not found (404) ane soft 404 lists. redirect chains: a → b → c hoy to a → c direct karo (max 1 hop). redirect loop: a → b → a - page khule j nahi, tarat fix. nirnay no niyam 404 page par backlinks ke traffic hoy → nearest relevant page par 301 koi value nathi ane replacement nathi → 404/410 rehva do internal broken link → link j update karo (redirect par aadhar na rakho) checklist monthly crawl: 0 internal broken links koi redirect chain ke loop nathi backlink vala 404 pages ne 301 aapela search ane popular links sathe custom 404 page

schema = code (json-ld format) je google ane ai systems ne page vishe clear facts aape: aa product chhe, price aatlo, brand aa, business kya chhe. schema direct ranking boost nathi aapto (confirmed), pan rich results (stars, price) ane machine understanding mate useful chhe. website type pramane jaruri schema badhi sites: organization (logo, socials, contact), website, breadcrumblist local business: localbusiness (nap, hours, geo) - gbp sathe exact match ecommerce: product offer (price, availability, currency), review/rating fakt jo real reviews page par visible hoy blog: article/blogposting (author, datepublished, datemodified) important 2026 update google e 7 may 2026 thi faq rich results search ma batavvana band karya chhe (confirmed - google search central). faq section page par users ane aeo mate hju useful chhe, pan faq schema thi have rich result nahi male. pehla howto (2023) ane bija ghana types pan retire thaya chhe - navo schema add karta pehla google docs ma type supported chhe ke nahi check karo. steps page type pramane schema type select karo. implement: wordpress ma rankmath/yoast, shopify ma theme ma default product schema hoy - check karo, jarur hoy to app/json-ld. validate: rich results test (google) + validator.schema.org. monitor: gsc → enhancements/shopping reports ma errors. common mistakes (aa bhool na karo) page par na dekhaye tevi info schema ma (fake rating) - manual action risk schema price ane page price alag duplicate schema - theme + plugin banne

images speed na sauthi common karano ma ek ane google images traffic no source - banne. ecommerce ma product images j sales kare chhe. rules (niyamo) file name: upload pehla rename - img_4521.jpg nahi, eggless-chocolate-cake.webp. alt text: image ma su chhe te 5-15 words ma describe karo. keyword naturally aave to saru, stuffing nahi. decorative images mate alt empty. format: webp (ya avif), compress karelu. product image 100-200 kb target. size: display size jetli j image - 4000px image 400px box ma nahi. width/height attributes: layout shift (cls) avoid karva. lazy load: fold ni niche ni images lazy. page ni main (lcp) image lazy nahi. ecommerce extra (vadhu) har product ni unique real photos - manufacturer ni same images badha sellers pase hoy alag-alag angles + use-case photo + size reference variant images alag (color pramane) kevi rite check karvu screaming frog → images → missing alt text, over 100 kb pagespeed insights → "properly size images", "serve images in next-gen formats" checklist content images ma missing alt text 0 varnanatmak file names webp compressed, lcp image lazy nathi

8.6 technical seo audit (screaming frog crawl) — seo sop express home station → journey → dabbo 08 🛠️ → 8.6 🛠️ 8.6 — technical seo audit (screaming frog crawl) dabbo 08 · technical seo · ✅ done ☑️ mark done 📍 set current stop 6 month plan na month 1 ma "full audit" lakhel chhe - aa doc te audit kevi rite karvo te batave. audit = list of issues nahi, priority sathe action plan. 8.6.a steps crawl: screaming frog (free 500 urls) ma domain nakho. mode: spider. response codes: 3xx, 4xx, 5xx ni list (technical point 03). indexability: noindex, canonicalised, blocked pages - intentional chhe? (technical point 01, 02). page titles + meta: missing, duplicate, limit karta vadhare lamba. h1: missing, ek karta vadhare, duplicate. images: alt text missing, size moto. crawl depth: money pages 3 clicks thi vadhare deep na hova joiye. gsc data sathe match: pages report, core web vitals, manual actions, security issues. 8.6.b priority kevi rite nakki karvi critical: site/money pages index nathi, noindex/robots bhool, site-wide redirect issue - tarat high: money pages par duplicate/canonical issue, broken internal links, slow mobile medium: meta missing, alt text missing, redirect chains low: cosmetic (title thodu lambu) rule: "ketla urls affected" x "te pages ni business value" = priority. 500 blog tags par missing meta < 5 product pages noindex. 8.6.c output sheet: issue | example urls | count | impact | effort | priority | owner | status 8.6.d checklist full crawl thai gayu + gsc data sathe cross-check karyu issues priority sathe listed critical issues 1 week ma fixed 8.6.e added 16 nov 2026 - audit ma extra checks big/programmatic site hoy to crawl-budget ane log-file analysis pan add karo multi-country (usa + uk) hoy to hreflang tags pan check karo navi page publish karta pehla 5.13 pre-publish checklist follow karo 8.6.f semrush site audit (semrush sop - added 19 nov 2026) complete step-by-step sop for weekly website auditing, pdf reporting and issue fixes 1. purpose and weekly schedule run a complete semrush site audit for the Client A website every monday. download the full site audit pdf report and save it in the designated google drive folder. review every issue listed in the report, prepare a fix list, and complete the fixes that are approved and within scope. after fixes, verify the affected pages/issues and record the completion status. when required activity every monday create/run the site audit, wait for crawl completion, export pdf. after report download review issues, prioritize fixes and record affected urls. during the week implement approved fixes and verify the results. next monday run the next audit and compare remaining/new issues. 2. open site audit log in to the semrush shared account. open site performance / site audit from the semrush navigation. go to the site audit page where the create button is available. 3. if semrush shows the website-monitoring limit message message to look for: “you’ve reached your limit of websites to monitor.” open a separate browser tab and go to https://semrss.jupiterseotool.com/home. find the projects area and search for the project that is no longer needed and is occupying the shared account’s project limit. before deleting anything, verify the exact project name/domain and confirm that it is obsolete, unused and not needed by another team member. do not delete an active project or another person’s required work. for a confirmed obsolete project, open its three-dot menu and choose delete. if the platform requests a confirmation code, follow the on-screen confirmation process and enter the code only in the semrush interface. never share the code in chat or store it in this sop. return to semrush site audit and refresh the page. confirm that the website-monitoring limit has been released. safety rule: deleting a project is a destructive action. if the project owner or purpose is unclear, stop and get approval before deleting it. do not delete a project simply because it appears first in the list. 4. create a new site audit project on the site audit page, click create. in the “website” field, enter the website to audit. in the “name” field, enter the business/project name in a clear format. field example website https://client-a-store.com/ name client-a-store click the button to create/continue the project. wait approximately 2–5 minutes for the next setup section or “new audit” popup to appear. actual loading time may vary. 5. configure the new audit settings setting required selection / value scope client-a-store.com subdomains enable “including all subdomains” as specified in this workflow. limit per audit 1,000 pages pages to crawl website schedule once send an email once an audit is complete untick / disable this checkbox. review the settings carefully before starting the audit. click the final start / start audit / confirm button shown in the popup. confirm that the status message “preparing to crawl…” appears. 6. wait for the crawl to finish after “preparing to crawl…” appears, wait approximately 15–20 minutes for the crawl to begin and process pages. the actual time depends on site size and crawl conditions. return to the /siteaudit page and refresh it after the initial wait. check the project’s page count. if it is still increasing, allow more time. while the count is increasing, refresh/check approximately every 10 minutes. when the crawled page count stops increasing and the audit status indicates completion, open the project. do not treat a temporarily unchanged count as completion if the status still says crawling or processing. 7. open the completed audit and confirm crawl details click the project name, for example “client-a-store”, to open the audit. the navigation path should show: home → seo → site audit. review the audit summary before exporting. example field example value from the supplied notes site audit www.julyhouse.vn (illustrative example) updated thu, nov 19, 2026 (illustrative example) device mobile js rendering disabled pages crawled 139/500 the example values above are only a visual reference. for Client A, record the actual audit date, device, javascript rendering setting and pages crawled/page limit shown in the live report. 8. export the full site audit pdf in the audit report, click the pdf/export option in the corner. when the “report template” popup opens, select “site audit: full report”. wait approximately one minute for the report template to load. leave the “export settings” unchanged, as specified in this workflow. in the export options, choose “download pdf”. do not choose email sharing or online dashboard unless separately requested. save the pdf to the designated Client A google drive folder. use a consistent filename, for example: Client A-stone-site-audit-yyyy-mm-dd.pdf. confirm that the downloaded pdf opens correctly and includes the full report. 9. review the pdf and prepare the fix list read the full pdf from beginning to end. do not review only the summary score. list every issue semrush reports and capture the affected url(s), issue description, severity/priority and recommended action where shown. group issues by type so that similar fixes can be handled together. prioritize critical errors first, then high-priority warnings, then lower-priority notices. confirm the actual impact before changing the website. check whether an issue is valid for the page/site before implementing a fix. some audit recommendations may not apply to the site’s intended setup. fix tracker column what to record audit date date the site audit was completed issue name exact issue title from semrush severity error / warning / notice or displayed priority affected url(s) all relevant urls shown in the report recommended fix action needed to resolve the issue owner person responsible for the fix status open / in progress / fixed / not applicable verification how and when the fix was checked 10. implement and verify fixes work through the approved fix

navu design, navu platform (wordpress → shopify) ke navu domain - aa seo nu sauthi risky kaam chhe. redirects bhuli gaya to mahinao ni ranking ek divas ma jay. design & web development section sathe aa follow karvu jaruri. launch pehla old site no full crawl + gsc top pages + backlink vala pages export. redirect map: old url | new url - dar important url 1:1 relevant page par 301. badhu homepage par redirect nahi. titles, meta, h1, content ane internal links navi site ma carry karo - kharab design change ok, content loss nahi. staging site noindex/password protected - pan launch time te hatavvu yaad rakho. launch divas robots.txt ma disallow: / nathi te check noindex tags remove karo redirect map test karo (screaming frog list mode) navu sitemap gsc + bing ma submit; domain change hoy to gsc change of address ga4/gtm tracking live chhe te confirm launch pachhi (6-8 week) dar week gsc: 404, indexing drop, top queries ni position thodo fluctuation 2–6 week normal; pan motu drop (20%+) ke 404 vadhe to tarat redirects/indexing check - raah na juo redirects ochama ochu 1 varas rakho checklist redirect map 100% important urls cover kare launch divas na checks thai gaya before/after traffic compare sheet taiyar chhe

1. crawl budget kyare jovo site ma ghana hajar urls (filters, tags, programmatic pages) hoy. gsc → settings → crawl stats: requests, response codes, avg response time. "discovered currently not indexed" ghana hoy. 2. waste ghatadvo parameter/filter urls control (canonical, noindex, robots - 08/02, 08/03). redirect chains ane 404 ghatadvo (08/03). sitemap ma fakat indexable, 200-status, canonical urls. server speed (ttfb) saru - slow server = google ochhu crawl kare. strong internal links important pages ne (05/03). 3. log files (advanced, optional) server log mathi googlebot hits joi shakay: kaya urls crawl thay, kaya nahi. tool: screaming frog log file analyser (ke hosting logs). googlebot verify karo (fake bots hoy). important page googlebot ne dekhatu nathi to internal link / sitemap sudharo. 4. javascript seo rule: important content + links normal html ma hova joiye (anchor tag with href). test: gsc url inspection → view tested page → screenshot/html. content dekhay chhe? view-source vs rendered html compare. content fakat js thi aave to risk. best: server-side rendering ya static html for money pages. lazy-load images ma above-the-fold image lazy na karo. click par j khulta tabs/accordion content ne google read kare, pan fakat button click thi load thay (api call) to nahi. checklist crawl stats joyu, 5xx nathi. important page rendered html ma content + links chhe. sitemap clean.

1. structure pasand karo option example kyare same page, ek english / content same, fakat price/shipping notes alag subfolder /us/ , /uk/ best for most (ek domain ni authority) cctld .co.uk strong local brand, alag budget 2. hreflang (jo be ke vadhu versions hoy) darek version page par badha j versions ni hreflang tag (potani sahit - self reference). codes: en-us, en-gb, x-default (fallback). return links jaruri: us page uk ne point kare to uk page us ne point kare. absolute urls, canonical same page par self. implement: html head, ke sitemap ma. ek j method rakho. 3. content localisation uk spelling (colour, jewellery) vs us (color, jewelry), uk vs us keywords alag check karo (semrush ma database us ane uk). currency, shipping time, returns, vat/tax notes, size units. pure copy-paste duplicate nahi - thodu localise. 4. measure gsc → performance → country filter (united states / united kingdom). ga4 ma country wise sessions + key events. mistakes automatic ip redirect (googlebot ne block thai jay) - bhale suggestion banner aapo. hreflang return link na hovi.

ecommerce ma sauthi vadhare buying keywords ("kids makeup kit", "leather belts for men") category/collection pages par rank kare chhe, product pages par nahi. etle category page = ecommerce nu main money page. optimize kevi rite keyword: category ne transactional keyword map karo (keyword mapping doc juvo). 1 keyword = 1 collection. title + h1: "kids makeup kits" jevu clear, generic "shop all" nahi. intro text: grid ni upar 1-3 line short intro (user mate); vadhare helpful content (buying guide, faq) grid ni niche. product grid: best sellers/in-stock pehla - out-of-stock products last ma. internal links: sub-collections, related collections ane 2-3 related blogs ne link. breadcrumbs: home > category > sub-category (breadcrumblist schema sathe). shopify mate khas collection description theme ma visible chhe te check karo - ghana themes ma hidden hoy automated collections ma pan manual seo title + meta set karo tags/filters thi bani nava urls index na thay (ecommerce point 03) common mistakes (aa bhool na karo) be collections ma same products + same keyword = cannibalization empty ke 1-2 product vali collection index ma - thin page blog thi product par link aapo pan collection par nahi checklist har collection: alag title, h1, meta, shuruaat nu text collection-keyword mapping sheet ma blogs → collections na internal links active chhe

product page long-tail ane brand/model keywords par rank kare chhe ane conversion nu last step chhe. kharab product page = traffic aave pan sale nahi. must-have elements (jaruri vastu-o) title: product name + main attribute ("organic kids lip balm - strawberry, 4g"). brand end ma. unique description: manufacturer copy nahi - benefits, use-case, who it's for, ingredients/material, size. images: multiple, real, alt text sathe (image seo doc). price, stock, delivery time, return policy - fold ni upar ke najik. reviews: real customer reviews page par visible. product schema: name, image, price, currency, availability, brand (schema doc). related products + parent collection ni link. merchant listings (free) google merchant center ma products add karo to shopping tab ane free listings ma batay - organic product visibility mate. shopify ma google & youtube app thi connect thay. price/stock site ane feed ma same hova joiye. common mistakes (aa bhool na karo) 100 products ni same description (duplicate content) description fakt image ma - google text vanchi na shake schema ma price/stock page thi alag checklist top 20 sauthi vadhu vechata products: alag description product schema valid chhe (rich results test) merchant center connected chhe, feed errors 0

ecommerce sites par filters (color, size, price, sort) hajaro urls banave chhe. aa badha google crawl/index kare to crawl budget waste thay ane index ma thin duplicate pages bharay (index bloat). problem kevi rite olkhvo gsc → pages: indexed count products+collections thi ghanu vadhare site:domain.com inurl:filter ke ?sort_by search screaming frog ma parameter urls ni count decision (nirnay) search demand vala filter ("black leather belt" - real volume) → alag optimized collection page banavo, filter url nahi. baki filters/sort → canonical main collection par, internal linking ma use na karo. crawl waste motu hoy → robots.txt thi parameter patterns block (shopify ma robots.txt.liquid). pan dhyan: already indexed urls pehla canonical/noindex thi nikalo, pachhi block. shopify duplicate product urls /collections/x/products/y ane /products/y - shopify canonical /products/y par set kare chhe pan theme collection page parthi /collections/.../products/... link kare to google ne mixed signal - theme ma product links direct /products/ par karo variants (?variant=123) canonical main product par - alag page fakt jo variant nu potanu search demand hoy checklist indexed filter/parameter urls ni count track high-demand filters mate dedicated collections theme product links /products/ format ma

stock khatam thay tyare page delete karvu sauthi common bhool chhe - ranking, backlinks ane reviews badhu jay. temporary ane permanent case alag handle karo. temporary out-of-stock page live rakho, index ma rakho. "back in stock soon" + expected date + notify-me option. similar in-stock products page par batavo. availability update: site schema ma https://schema.org/outofstock ane merchant feed ma out_of_stock (banne same hova joiye). collection ma product niche khaso. permanently discontinued navu version/replacement chhe → 301 replacement product par replacement nathi pan close category chhe ane page par traffic/backlinks chhe → 301 relevant collection par koi value nathi → 404/410 badha discontinued products homepage par 301 nahi - google ene soft 404 gane seasonal products diwali/christmas jeva products na urls varas-varas same rakho (date vagar slug) - juni ranking aavta varase kaam aave. checklist out-of-stock policy written ane team ne khabar discontinued list monthly review + redirects schema/feed availability accurate

steps merchants.google.com → account banavo, website claim + verify. policy pages ready: shipping, returns, contact, privacy (05 on-page / 05). product feed: shopify/woocommerce app ke google sheet feed. fields: id, title, description, link, image_link, price, availability, brand, gtin/mpn (jo hoy), condition. product page par product schema (price + availability) feed sathe match thavu joiye (08/04). diagnostics ma errors ane warnings fix karo (merchant center ma "needs attention"). free listings (surfaces across google) on. rules price ane stock site par ane feed ma same (09/04 out-of-stock). image clean, white background, product clear, koi watermark ke promo text nahi. title ma brand + product + key attribute (color, size). monthly check disapproved products 0 ke ochha. gsc merchant listings report joyu.

1. etsy listing seo keyword: buyer je words search kare. etsy search bar suggestions, alura/erank jevu tool, google trends. title: sauthi important keyword pehla; natural, stuffing nahi (140 char limit). tags: badha 13 vapro, long-tail phrases (single words nahi). attributes categories bharo (occasion, color, style) - etsy filters ma aave. first photo + 10 photos, video; thumbnail clear. photo = click rate. description: first 1-2 lines ma keywords + value; faq, delivery (digital download), file format. reviews fast response; shop policies, about section, shop announcement. 2. own store sathe jodvu same product ni description etsy ane website par alag shabdo ma (duplicate avoid - [likely] precaution). website par product page ma "buy on etsy" button (ga4 event click_buy_etsy 07 setup / 07). etsy shop ma website link jya policy allow kare; etsy rules vanchi lo. brand name, logo, shop name badhe same (06 off-page / 08 brand). 3. amazon title, bullets, backend keywords, a+ content; keyword research amazon search bar thi. website ne amazon par traffic mokalva ma amazon rules check karo (link policy). 4. weekly check (20 min) etsy stats: visits, views, favourites, conversion. low views listing → title/tags/photo badlo. ek vakhat ma ek j change, date note karo (4-6 week result).

client kahe "traffic ghati gayu" - panic nahi, step-by-step investigation. pehla confirm karo ke real drop chhe, pachhi kya ane kem. step-by-step data confirm: ga4 tracking tuti to nathi? gsc ma pan drop chhe? (ga4 drop + gsc stable = mostly tracking/consent issue). seasonality: last year same mahina sathe compare. kya drop: gsc ma pages, queries, device, country wise compare - site-wide ke amuk pages? impressions vs clicks: impressions same pan clicks ghata = ctr issue (serp change, ai overviews, title). banne ghata = ranking/indexing issue ke demand/seasonality ghati (yoy + google trends check). technical: recent site changes, noindex, robots.txt, redirects, gsc pages report ma indexed drop. google update: google search status dashboard par te dates ma core/spam update? manual actions + security issues (gsc). competitors: serp ma kon upar aavyu ane temni page tamara thi kem better chhe. pattern → sambhavit karan achanak site-wide 80% drop → technical (noindex/robots/migration) ke manual action dhime dhime drop amuk pages par → content outdated / competitors better update date sathe match → quality issue - content ane eeat improve (quick fix nathi) checklist drop size + date + affected pages document karela chhe evidence sathe cause hypothesis client ne clear explanation + action plan added 8 nov 2026 — 2026 google updates timeline + ai check 2026 updates: feb — discover core update (~22 days) · march — core update + spam update · may — broad core update (complete ~2 june)

junu content ignore karvu = slow decline. dar quarter content audit karo ane dar page mate ek decision lo: keep, update, merge, remove ke create new. data levo pages ni list (sitemap/crawl) + gsc clicks/impressions (12 months) + ga4 key events + backlinks decision rules (nirnayo na niyamo) keep: saru traffic + conversions - fakt monitor. update: impressions chhe pan position 5-20 ke traffic ghatyu - content refresh (strategy point 2). merge: 2-3 pages same intent par (cannibalization) - strongest page ma content merge, baki 301. remove: no traffic, no links, no business value, outdated - 404/410 (ya relevant hoy to 301). create new: navu intent je koi page cover nathi kartu. cannibalization kevi rite olkhvo gsc → query select → pages tab: same query par 2+ pages alternately rank thay fakt be pages dekhay etle cannibalization nathi - intent same hoy ane banne weak hoy tyare j problem common mistakes (aa bhool na karo) fakt word count vadharvu = refresh nathi; information gain (navu data, example, experience) add karo date badli ne kai change nahi - misleading traffic vagar pan conversion vala pages delete karva checklist dar quarter ni content audit sheet: url | metrics | nirnay | puru merged pages par 301 + internal links updated

t: 1. Core Principles: Modern Search Framework (SEO + GEO + AEO + SXO)
x: traditional search optimization focused solely on keyword placement and backlinks to earn top positions in standard search engine results pages. modern search requires a unified strategy across four foundational pillars: pillar focus area execution strategy seo traditional search keyword targeting, technical architecture, and internal linking to rank in google blue links. aeo answer engines placing a concise 40–60 word summary at the top of content to capture featured snippets and voice answers. geo / aio generative ai optimizing for brand mentions and entity citations inside chatgpt, gemini, perplexity, and google ai overviews. sxo search experience improving core web vitals, mobile usability, fast load times, and conversion paths upon user arrival. e-e-a-t trust layer experience & expertise: content must feature verified author credentials, direct hands-on observations, and authentic domain knowledge. authoritativeness & trust: zero tolerance for fake stats or hallucinated data. every claim must be backed by accurate source citation or primary research.

keep discovery and optimization workflows strictly separated to prevent scope creep and keyword cannibalization. strategy 1: new topic discovery analyze niche: define exact target topics based on primary products, services, and core audience pain points. map existing assets: catalog all published blogs, urls, and landed keywords across the domain. build exclusion map: cross-reference prospective topics against existing urls to ensure no overlapping keyword intent. identify gaps: select unaddressed user questions and informational queries that map directly back to business services or catalog products. strategy 2: gsc low-click / high-impression optimization export gsc data: filter google search console performance data for the last 3 months. isolate striking distance queries: filter for queries occupying positions 5–20 with high impressions but low click-through rates (ctr). cluster & map: group related striking-distance queries around a single central topic. create supporting assets: write high-intent informational blogs targeting these query clusters. funnel page equity: link all new supporting articles directly back to primary commercial/money pages (never create competing commercial landing pages).

rule requirement implementation 1 page = 1 primary keyword core focus include within the page title (first 50–60 characters), url slug, h1 tag, and naturally within the first 100 words. 3–5 secondary keywords context & depth distribute across h2/h3 subheadings, body paragraphs, and dedicated faq sections. intent alignment match searcher goal informational: educational blogs/guides.commercial: product comparisons/reviews.transactional: service or product sales pages. winnability check feasibility first for new or growing domains, target low-difficulty keywords (kd 0–30) rather than broad high-volume terms.

product selection & link insertion relevance limit: feature a maximum of 5 closely related products from your store catalog per article. anchor text rule: avoid using exact, full product names in running prose. instead, use natural, 2–5 word lowercase descriptive anchor text (e.g., use "lightweight running shoes" instead of "men's apex vaporfly pro 2024 edition"). product image pattern include product visual callouts using the structured layout below: alt text: [lowercase natural descriptive alt text] (space for photo) collection & category linking integrate the targeted parent category or collection url exactly 2 times within the article body. use rich, descriptive anchor text. never use generic anchors such as "click here", "link", or "buy now".

one line each: seo — traditional search (google) ma rank karvu. geo — ai models (chatgpt, gemini, claude…) tamaru brand reference/cite kare. aeo — search par direct answer banvu (snippet, voice). aio — ai overview (google ai overview, bing copilot) ma dekhavu. sxo — user site par aavya pachhi no experience optimize karvo (ux + conversion). pillar shu means kem kaam kare (signals) real example seo search engine opt. google jeva engine ma high rank keyword research, on-page, quality backlinks, technical seo "best running shoes" → ranked blog "10 best running shoes 2026" geo generative engine opt. ai models brand ne reference kare ai-friendly content, structured data, expert authority, trusted sources ai ne "best crm software?" → hubspot · salesforce · zoho (cited) aeo answer engine opt. search par direct answer banvu question-based content, clear concise answers, faq schema, zero-click "what is digital marketing?" → clear definition first dekhaay aio ai overview opt. ai-generated overview ma dekhavu topical authority, multi-source credibility, semantic relevance, entity optimization "crm software comparison" → ai overview sources: hubspot · salesforce · zoho sxo search experience opt. landing pachi ux + conversion fast loading, mobile-friendly, clear cta, trust signals landing page "run further" → shop now (fast · mobile · trusted) note: aio ne kayak jagyae "ai integration optimization" pan kahe chhe (content ne ai tools/apis vaapri shake evi rite structure karvi) — concept sa

aeo etle: user na question no clear, direct answer aapvo, jethi google na answer-box / featured snippet ma dekhaay. featured snippet ane zero-click aa j family chhe. analogy — busy teacher: google ne busy teacher samjo. "aaje homework kone anyu?" — 10 min ni story kaho to teacher confuse. "sir, homework aa file ma chhe" — instant clear. aeo aa j: answer first, story later. search intent — aeo nu foundation: same keyword, alag intent. answer aapta pehla user shu karva mange chhe e pakdo: informational → "what is piles?" → definition how-to → "how to treat at home?" → numbered steps comparison → "medicine vs surgery" → table commercial → "best piles medicine" → options + proof transactional → "buy x" → product + cta local → "best doctor in surat" → local + reviews golden rule: keyword nahi, intent vadhu important. featured snippet: google no highlighted answer box. guarantee nathi, pan clean structure thi chance vadhe. analogy: answer "plate saaf" kari ne aapo, spoon-feed nahi — machine mate extract easy bane. zero-click: user ne serp par j answer mali jaay, click na kare. aa failure nathi — visibility, brand ne authority pan value chhe. aeo formula: ask → answer → format → prove → measure

geo etle: ai systems (chatgpt, gemini, perplexity, ai search) tamaru brand + content samje, trust kare ane answer ma cite/mention kare. analogy — smart waiter: customer puche "aa area ma best healthy meal kya?" — tamari info (menu, location, reviews, mentions) badhe clear ne consistent hoy to waiter confidently recommend kare; adhuri/contradictory hoy to "khabar nathi bhai." ai ne pan evi j clear story joiye. ai ne 4 vaat joiye: entity — tame kon chho (brand, service, location). answer — user na questions solve thaay. original value — internet par same na hoy evi useful info (data, case study, cost breakdown). trust — author, proof, reviews, honest claims + third-party mentions. analogy 2: ai ne "guess the movie" na ramadvo — character, location, story badhu clearly aapo. geo formula: entity → answer → original → trust → sources → test

shu chhe: llms.txt ek markdown file chhe je ai systems / llms ne samjave ke tamari website par kayu content sauthi important chhe. robots.txt jem search crawlers ne guide karto, em llms.txt ai agents ne discover, interpret ane accurately cite karva ma help kare. kem important (benefits): ai ne priority pages ane content structure samjaay. ai-powered search / assistants ma discoverability vadhe. aeo ne support kare. geo strategy ne strong kare. tamara valuable content ne structured access aape. kem kaam kare (3 step): tame llms.txt banavo. ai agents ene read/understand kare. tamaru content ai systems dwara cite ne recommend thaay. line yaad rakho: "be the source ai chooses to cite." content ai-friendly banavo. (more: llmstxt.org)

real example: "does piles medicine work immediately?" h1 = question j → "does piles medicine work immediately?" direct answer first (40–60 words, koi long intro nahi): bad (answer chhupave): "piles is a common condition… various treatment options available…" good (answer first): "no. piles medicine usually immediately kaam nathi karti. kayak treatment kalak ma relief aape; noticeable improvement ma several days lage. timeline type, severity, diet ane individual response par depend kare." format = intent pramane — para / list / table / steps. h2 = follow-up questions (people also ask mathi): how long does it take? → timeline what affects recovery? → factors how to support recovery? → steps when to see a doctor? → warning signs faq = real user questions (fake faq nahi). internal links → relevant service/category page. (analogy: article = island, internal link = bridge; bridge vagar traffic atke.) schema → page par jetlu actual content chhe etlu j accurate markup. fake markup nahi. measure → gsc ma impressions, clicks, queries, ctr joyo.

(500 spammy listings nahi; relevance + quality.) test → same query chatgpt / gemini / perplexity ma nakho: brand aavyu? cite thayu? competitor kayu? kayo source cite thayo? → gap fix karo, periodically retest. platform focus (1 line each): platform shu par focus chatgpt clear entity + helpful content + trusted external sources gemini entity + google business + local/structured info perplexity original research + citation-friendly + sources bing copilot bing indexable + entity + local proof note: algorithms change thaay — fixed formula na samajo, real queries thi test karta raho.

common mistakes (na karo): answer 5 paragraph pachhi aapvo (answer hiding). keyword stuffing — same question 20 vaar. fake faq, fake reviews, fake stats, unsupported medical/legal claims. page par na hoy e schema markup (schema abuse). generic ai article copy-paste — original value 0. optimize kari ne measure na karvu. 10-minute practice: ek keyword lo → user no exact question → intent → 40–60 word direct answer → 5 follow-up questions → darek no format → 2 internal links → 1–2 proof → page structure → publish → gsc ne ai ma check. copy-paste template: primary keyword: ___ user question: ___ search intent: ___ direct answer (40–60w): ___ follow-up qs (5): ___ format per q: ___ proof / source: ___ internal links (2): ___ schema: ___ cta: ___ ai test (chatgpt/gemini/perplexity): ___ next action: ___

t: 1. Google Discover Shu Chhe? (What is Discover?)
x: google discover acts as a personalized feed tailored directly to every user's interests, similar to social media feeds on instagram or facebook. personalized feed: jem instagram ke facebook par tamaru personal feed / scroll hoy chhe, evuj aa google nu feed chhe. query-less discovery: ahiya user e kashu search nathi karvu padtu. google pote user na interest ane search history pramane articles, videos ane blogs samethi batavse. surge potential: etle j amathi aavto traffic achanak (surprise traffic) aavi shake chhe.

t: 2. Website Discover ma Keviri Rite Aave? (Eligibility Requirements)
x: getting into discover requires zero special code or plugins—it operates automatically once technical and content standards are met. automatic process: aa ekdam automatic chhe, koi special setting ke code ni jarur nathi. two fundamental rules (be basic sharato): indexing required: website google ma index thayeli hovi joie (google ne khabar hovi joie ke site exist kare chhe). policy compliance: content google ni content policies (spam na hovu joie, dangerous content na hovu joie) nu palan kartu hovu joie. important note: dhyan rakho: eligible hovano matlav guarantee nathi ke tame discover ma dekhasho j.

t: 3. Discover ma Aavvana Chances Keviri Rite Vadharva? (Optimization Action Steps)
x: follow these technical and editorial best practices to optimize your content visibility: 1. clear & catchy titles vapro title evu lakho je article nu sachu varnan kartu hoy. clickbait thi bacho (khoota shocking shabdo vapari loko ne lalachavva nahi). 2. high-quality & large images muko discover moti ane attractive images ne vadhare pasand kare chhe. main image ni width ochha ma ochhi 1200 pixels hovi joie. website no logo kyarey main image tarike na vapro. 3. honest previews aapo matra click melavva mate bhamrak title, summary ke photo na vapro. 4. people-first content banavo trending topics: je topics atyare trending ma chhe tena par lakho. good storytelling: vanchak ne maja aave tevi rite saral vat karo. unique insights: bije kyay na male tevi potani navi mahiti uméro. avoid outrage: gussa ke outrage felave tevu content na banavo.

chrome browser allows users to directly follow websites to receive newly published updates directly into their discover feed. implementation checklist website par rss ke atom feed hovi joie (wordpress ma by default hoy chhe). website na <head> section ma aa link tag add karo: <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml" href=" https://yourwebsite.com/feed/"\ >

t: 5. Discover no Traffic Kem Vadhat-Ghatat Thay Chhe? (Understanding Volatility)
x: discover traffic is inherently volatile compared to organic search traffic. factor description & impact shift in user interest loko no ras badlay to google oochhu batavse. content naturally trends in and out of interest cycles. algorithm updates core algorithm updates thi traffic badlay shake chhe without prior warning. expected behavior discover no traffic fix nathi rahyo—ek divase lakhoma views aave ane bija divase ghani ochhi thay shake chhe. traffic ghate to dar vakhte tamari bhul j hoy tevu jaruri nathi.

t: 6. Performance Keviri Rite Check Karvu? (Tracking & Analytics)

t: 4. Modern Search: SEO vs AEO vs GEO & Content Strategy
x: q: seo, aeo ane geo no difference su chhe? optimization type core objective primary target strategy focus seo (search engine optimization) rank in top organic search listings search engine results pages (serps) keywords, technical seo, backlinks, on-page aeo (answer engine optimization) capture position 0 & direct answers featured snippets, voice search (siri/alexa) concisely structured answers, faq schema geo (generative engine optimization) secure citation in ai responses gemini, chatgpt, perplexity, ai overviews first-party data, e-e-a-t, brand entity authority optimization workflow for geo & helpful content: bluf approach (bottom line up front): provide the direct core answer within the first two sentences. structured data: comprehensive implementation of faqpage and howto schemas. e-e-a-t signals: detailed author credentials, original primary research, case studies, and proprietary data points. originality verification: pass strict ai and plagiarism checks while injecting authentic human expertise and lived experience.

q: jo 20,000 pages koi site ma hoy ane ee index na thay to tamaro step-by-step approach su rahe? google search console deep-dive analysis: 'discovered currently not indexed': indicates crawl budget constraints, server response latency, or weak internal link hierarchy. 'crawled currently not indexed': points to perceived low content quality, thin content, or internal duplication. excluded by noindex / canonical mismatch: technical directive misconfigurations. technical crawlability checks: audit robots.txt for unintended disallow rules. analyze time to first byte (ttfb) and resolve intermittent 5xx server failures. xml sitemap segmentation: segment 20,000 pages into smaller sitemaps of 1,000–2,000 urls grouped by category or directory to isolate indexation drop-offs. internal link architecture: pass link equity from high-authority pages using contextual internal links, optimized breadcrumb paths, and static html sitemaps to resolve orphan pages. q: koi new website hoy to tame kai rite seo start karo ane ketlo time estimate thay? month 1: foundation & technical setup console setups (gsc, ga4), core technical site audit, domain structure planning, entity branding profiles creation. month 2: low-hanging fruit execution targeting long-tail keywords (kd < 25), structural core service page optimization, search intent mapping. month 3: topical authority & hub-and-spoke content deployment of e-e-a-t rich pillar pages, supporting clusters, schema integration, and internal link routing.

q: current company kem chodo cho / kem change karva mango cho? answer: "current company nu business model mostly in-house/personal projects par based chhe ane external client work diversify thai ne out-source thay chhe. aa lidhe mane direct client-facing exposure ane diverse industry challenges par strategy test karvano scope limited male chhe. mari learning curve faster rakhva ane broad client accounts handle karva hu navi opportunity sodhu chhu." q: 8 hours daily current company ma su kaam karta hata? 09:00 am – 10:00 am: health check & performance monitoring reviewing google search console, ga4 analytics, rank tracking tools, and diagnosing sudden indexation or technical anomalies. 10:00 am – 12:30 pm: on-page & content strategy execution keyword mapping, content gap analysis, writing/optimizing title tags, meta descriptions, heading structures, and schema implementations. 01:30 pm – 03:30 pm: technical seo & engineering coordination crawling sites via screaming frog, coordinating with developers on core web vitals optimization, fixing 404 errors, and setting up redirect matrices. 03:30 pm – 05:00 pm: off-page seo & competitive intelligence analyzing competitor backlink profiles, managing high-quality outreach campaigns, and auditing link quality metrics. 05:00 pm – 06:00 pm: reporting, analytics & search algorithm research compiling client/executive performance dashboards, measuring conversion goals, and staying up to date with the latest google algorithm updates.
